title: Elili oyo ezali nsima ya kiti ya bokonzi
intro: Otelemi na kati ya lopango ya bokonzi moko ya nguya ya kala, epai mokonzi moko ya nguya amisakoli lokola nzambe likoló na bato nyonso. Pembeni ya mokonzi oyo atɛlɛmi mosaleli moko oyo amipesi, oyo bapesaki ye mikano minene ya bokonzi. Elongo, bazali kosala mwango mpe kosala mwango, bazali koboya koyoka makebisi ya momemi-nsango oyo atindamaki mpo na kotambwisa bango. Okoki koyeba soki mosaleli wana ya sembo azalaki nani?
clues: Nazalaki kofanda na bokonzi moko ya nguya oyo etambwisamaki na moto moko ya nguya oyo azalaki koloba ete azali bonzambe likoló ya bato nyonso.
Nasalaki lokola ministre oyo mokonzi oyo batyelaka motema, kokokisaka mposa na bango nyonso mpe etinda na bango.
Tango motindami moko ya Allah ayaki na mboka na biso kobenga biso na bosolo, ngai na mokonzi na ngai toboyaki koyoka.
Bapesaki ngai etinda ya kopelisa mɔ́tɔ monene mpe kobongisa babriki ya mabele ya lima mpo na botongi monene.
Mokonzi na ngai alingaki kotonga ndako molai makasi mpenza na boye ete ekokóma na likoló yango moko.
Nsukansuka, mokonzi na ngai, mampinga na biso, mpe ngai tomemamaki mpe tozindaki na bozindo ya mbu.

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Kotonga linɔ́ngi mpo na kokóma na likoló
Kobwakama na mɔtɔ oyo ezali kopela
Kolamuka bato moko na losambo ya bikeko ya mabanga
Kokabola sanza lokola elembo ya bonzambe
Kolonga engumba moko ya nguya na etinda ya Nzambe
trial.answer: Kotonga linɔ́ngi mpo na kokóma na likoló

location.label: Elemento ya ntina
options: Linɔ́ngi ya babriki ya mabele ya lima oyo batumbaki
Libumu ya baleine moko
Liziba moko mosantu na esobe
Nzete moko oyo ezali kozika na ngomba mosantu
Masuwa oyo ememaki libota moko oyo eponami
location.answer: Linɔ́ngi ya babriki ya mabele ya lima oyo batumbaki

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Azindaki na bozindo ya mbu
Totombolami na esika ya libateli na ndako moko ya mokonzi kitoko
Abikisami na libumu ya mbisi monene
Bakumisami na bokonzi mpe na mayele ya bonzambe
Ebongwanaki mputulu na kolela ya kotɔbɔla

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
